Hi Rajiv / Elena —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we discussed so we’re aligned on requirements and next steps. If I missed anything, please flag.

Pain points you shared
- Current system (in-house inference + S3-based logs) is spiking storage costs as log volume grows and retention policies are inconsistent across teams.
- Need to prove redaction/PII removal prior to logs leaving their VPC for audit/compliance teams.
- SOC 2 auditors want immutable audit trails for admin actions and per-request metadata for up to 18 months.

Current stack
- Primary models run in-house on Kubernetes with a proxy that emits JSON logs to S3.
- Observability via hosted Datadog (metrics) + in-house ELK for traces and search.
- Identity via Okta; encryption keys in AWS KMS.

Success criteria for a pilot (what will make this a win)
1) Demonstrable redaction pipeline that removes PII fields (names, SSNs, account numbers) before logs leave the tenant environment.
2) Retention policy enforcement (90 / 365 / 540 day tiers) configurable per-namespace and auditable.
3) Per-request metadata (model name + version, latency, cost tokens) surfaced for compliance reporting.
4) No material increase in end-user inference latency (<=5% overhead).

Constraints we need to validate
- All logs must be encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys and support HSM-backed KMS.
- Redaction must be deterministically provable (we discussed checksum-style evidence for removed fields).
- Admin actions must be tracked with immutable logs and exportable for auditors.

Next steps / owners
- Logan: deliver short tech note with recommended architecture options for redaction-before-export and two implementation patterns (edge redaction vs. runtime filter). Deliver by Wed 8/4.
- Marissa: prepare an example redaction policy file and a sanitized sample set from your log export for validation.
- Rajiv/Elena: share a representative 48-hour log snippet (sanitized if needed) and confirm the KMS model (customer-managed vs. Redwood-managed) by EOD 8/5.

Attachments included: questech-redaction-sample.pdf (PDF, sample redaction policy), questech-logging-matrix.xlsx (Excel, retention matrix)

Thanks again — I’ll circle back with the short tech note.

Best,
